ROOT CAUSE
[PRIMARY] ipa02.lab.test's Directory Server does not accept connections - confidence HIGH

ipa02.lab.test:443: open); an anonymous LDAP read gets no answer. The agreement's own status still shows its last sessio
n as successful (ended 2026-09-30T14:08:15Z); it has not recorded this yet.

il over or fail.

HANDOFF (the remaining evidence is on another server; nothing was changed)
On ipa02.lab.test run:
sudo ipa-diagnose replication --peer ipa01.lab.test
Why: ipa02.lab.test's Directory Server does not accept connections. The remaining evidence is local to ipa02.lab.test.
Nothing was changed on ipa01.lab.test or ipa02.lab.test; ipa-diagnose never changes another server.
RESOLUTION (only for causes on this server)
No fix is printed: the causes found are not on this server, or no fix is established for them (see HANDOFF and the nex
t read-only steps).
